title: Configure a scalar inside nested complex values
goal: Set the column and facets of a scalar several complex values deep with a chained member lambda; use this when configuring non-collection complex properties in EF Core 11.

selectionNotes: Complex properties; not arbitrary collections. Register the complex types, then configure a scalar path; no collection indexing, Select, method calls or navigation traversal is demonstrated.
The EF10 comparison is historical evidence, not an additional .NET 10 foundation or a claim EF11 runs on net10.0.

runtime.reason: EF Core 11 requires .NET 11. No older-runtime EF11 route is offered.

sdk.reason: Build the net11.0 consumer; measured SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 is RC2 evidence, not GA proof.

evidence.scope: Actual model facets and column name, SQLite TEXT schema creation, insert/read/update across fresh contexts. SQLite does not enforce HasMaxLength.
